title: NP Containment in BPNP
statement: Fix a verifier model $E$. Every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ belongs to $\mathrm{BPNP}$, the class of languages that reduce to $3$-CNF satisfiability in the randomized reduction relation determined by $E$.
